implementationRevision: LF-09 is the commit containing this evidence; LF-01 through LF-08 are recorded in implementation-plan.md.
changes: New source, import, popup and semantic saves use native receipts before any COLP dependency; previously submitted managed commands recover their immutable legacy receipts.
Native dispatch reads durable indexed active work, not retained save-plan history; readiness, claim leases and earliest-deadline wakes survive worker cuts.

Unknown membership reads retry within the source command budget; transient dependency failures stay pending; permanent observation problems remain visible and explicitly retryable under the original authority.
Ordinary Sync uploads the local node. Shared association uses an immutable adopt-only command for that exact canonical node, retaining its original transport owner.
Unbound local-only receipts acquire a separate transport command only after a selected Sync mapping proves an owner. Deletion during owner lookup cannot enqueue a new association.
Manual native edits/deletions close pending work. A late association receipt retains that closure and queues the corresponding shared ownership change.
Migration v2 is bounded and proof-based, retaining immutable command/native evidence and recovering only currently authorized observations or already-issued legacy commands.

Settings distinguish local saving, waiting for Sync/association, review and unknown progress; diagnostic timestamps separate accepted facts, planning, local native confirmation, uploaded mapping observation and association.

focusedCoverage: 5000 and 50000 retained completed plans do not get read or add dispatch rounds for new work; a newly inserted lower key runs on the next wake.
Failed work does not block unrelated tasks; claimed batches have restart recovery; later alarm scheduling cannot postpone an earlier wake.
Revoked unsent commands park for review while submitted/unknown commands continue recovering original late receipts.
Hint retries preserve identity; delayed unknown membership readback is not treated as absence; transient planner failures do not settle observations or starve later work.
Real native folders/bookmarks are created with no server, in an offline synced range, and while Sync is paused. Repeating execution creates no duplicate native bookmark.
Import/live overlap, restart-and-deduplicate, native crash recovery and unknown-without-replacement behavior pass.
Both source/semantic action orders and all copy policies pass, including real toolbar classification and independent provider failure/retry.
Lost adoption responses repeat the exact immutable command despite a changed parent projection. Range revocation during profile negotiation prevents dispatch.
Manual deletion during association dispatch or later owner lookup cannot reactivate or requeue the removed copy.
Migration preserves original submitted commands, native proof and reservations while rebuilding bounded active indexes.
Progress distinguishes local work from ordinary Sync idleness, remains scoped to source/owner, and reports unavailable storage honestly.

nativeTiming.boundary: After controlled plan preparation, sequential native folder and bookmark execution through the real MV3 capture kernel; excludes website readback, plan preparation, ordinary Sync and shared association.
nativeTiming.note: These are fixture samples, not a statistically established p95 or real-site end-to-end measurement. The one-second p95 design target remains a separate performance gate.

limits.concurrentDistinctNodes: Preserved locally and surfaced as association conflicts for explicit review. No automatic destructive cross-device merge is implemented or claimed.
limits.ordinarySync: This task uses the existing upload/Pull engine; the full unrelated Sync test matrix was not rerun.
limits.legacyCloudOperations: Explicit legacy cloud archive/reconciliation commands retain their server protocol. New normal saves do not depend on it.
limits.siteCoverage: Bilibili remains the only implemented adapter. Positive readback and source pacing limits still apply; negative readback and complete real-site live-trigger coverage are not newly qualified.
limits.compatibility: Older servers can leave native results intact while asynchronous association waits or reports an upgrade/review requirement.
limits.userServerEdits: Pre-existing changes in sync-evidence-maintenance-postgres.ts and sync-terminal-authority-cleanup.ts are excluded from these commits.

cleanup: All task-owned browser contexts and temporary profiles were closed/removed. No task-owned server or development service remains running.
